label: gym_esper_020_receptionist_01
text: Welcome to the Alfornada Gym! Would you like\nme to explain the rules of the Gym Test again?

label: gym_esper_020_receptionist_02
text: The Gym Test here is a special kind of [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]exercise[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]!

label: gym_esper_020_receptionist_03
text: I’m talking about the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Emotional Spectrum[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]\n[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Practice[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] created by Tulip herself, of course.\r\nComplete it, and you pass the test!

label: gym_esper_020_receptionist_04
text:
Head out of the Gym and turn left to find the
practice area.\c
The woman wearing a black tracksuit will explain
the rules to you there.

label: gym_esper_020_trainer_01
text: Osu! Welcome, new kid! This is where we do\nEmotional Spectrum Practice.[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: gym_esper_020_trainer_02
text: Why is your battle studies teacher here at a\nPokémon Gym working as an instructor, you ask?[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: gym_esper_020_trainer_03
text: Well, I’ve been friends with the Gym Leader\nhere, Tulip, since we were kids.[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: gym_esper_020_trainer_25
text: We decided to have a Pokémon battle with a\nspecial rule—the loser has to do what the winner\r\nsays. So we battled, and, well...[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: gym_esper_020_trainer_26
text: Look, never mind what happened! Point is, this is\na chance to both get a workout in and help my\r\nfriend when I don’t have classes![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: gym_esper_020_trainer_04
text:
The rules of Emotional Spectrum Practice—or ESP
for short—are simple!\c
I’ll show you a certain movement, and all you
have to do is copy it![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: gym_esper_020_trainer_05
text: Ready to get this Gym Test started? I hope your\nbody and mind are ready for the challenge![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: gym_esper_020_trainer_06
text: Great! Let’s get to exercising! Show me an\neruption of emotions![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: gym_esper_020_trainer_07
text: OK! Preparation is important, after all. Come\ntalk to me again when you’re good and ready![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: gym_esper_020_trainer_08
text: Nice! You’re moving really well! Both you and\nyour Pokémon are looking great, new kid![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: gym_esper_020_trainer_27
text: That was awesome! I can’t stop grinning after\nwitnessing such perfect power of expression![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: gym_esper_020_trainer_09
text: That’s enough of a warm-up! Now let’s really put\nthose muscles to work with a Pokémon battle![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: gym_esper_020_battle_a_01
text: You gotta keep moving! This is no ordinary\nbattle—this is a workout!

label: gym_esper_020_trainer_10
text: Great! I can hear your Pokémon AND your\nmuscles screaming with delight![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: gym_esper_020_trainer_11
text: I see you’re getting tired, but you’ve gotta hang\nin there! Time to start the second half![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: gym_esper_020_trainer_12
text: Covered in sweat and overflowing with emotion!\nThat was an impressive round![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: gym_esper_020_trainer_28
text: That was perfect! I almost lost track of who was\nteaching who![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: gym_esper_020_trainer_24
text: Don’t give up yet! It’s time for another battle!\nHold out against all that lactic acid![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: gym_esper_020_battle_b_01
text: My goal is to grow strong and build muscle.\nAny tips?

label: gym_esper_020_trainer_13
text: Good job! You made it all the way through the\nESP exercise![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: gym_esper_020_trainer_14
text: You passed this test—no doubt about it!\nCongratulations![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: gym_esper_020_trainer_15
text:
But you’re not done yet! Sprint over to the lobby
staffer on the double!\c
You have to report your passing grade to
formally finish the Gym Test![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: gym_esper_020_trainer_16
text: Awww, that was close! But it looks like you may\nneed to train a bit harder before you can take\r\non the Psychic-type Gym for real![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: gym_esper_020_trainer_17
text: If you don’t plan on giving up, come back again\nsometime and show me what you’re made of![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: gym_esper_020_trainer_18
text: Welcome back to the Emotional Spectrum\nPractice area, new kid![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
